summary: Busy residential street where cars park, but homes sit 12-17 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Houses and apartments 12-17 m away on both sides; no buffer of bush or park.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with parked cars along the kerb; room to park in line.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street near a junction at the east end; low traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along it, so a van blends in; signs are 2P with resident permits excepted.

flags: Steep: about 6% over best section, up to 24% elsewhere
sun_shade: Mostly open to sun; patchy tree shade on the south side near 100 m.

best_section.where: Depper Street south kerb, mid-block between the two apartment blocks
